posts.title: Using the same hostnames at home and over Tailscale

posts.title: My terminal-native setup for parallel coding agents
posts.description: In my previous post about Pi, I wrote about wanting a stable coding harness while the models underneath it keep changing. But one agent in one terminal is not the whole workflow. I increasingly have several agents working at once, sometimes in the same repository. The surprising part is that I manage that with a simpler stack: a terminal, Git worktrees, and a terminal multiplexer built for agents.

posts.title: Why Pi is my AI coding harness
